summary.text: Bryan Lawrence is a Republican member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 27B, in office since April 2024, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Lawrence's career experience includes working in agriculture and as a business owner.

paragraphs.text: Bryan Lawrence was born in Coon Rapids, Minnesota, and received a bachelor's degree in agricultural business administration from the University of Minnesota.
His career experience includes working in agriculture and as a business owner.
Lawrence succeeded Kurt Daudt in District 27B and assumed office on April 2, 2024.
For 2025 and 2026 he was assigned to the Agriculture Finance and Policy, Education Finance and Education Policy committees.
